job: Every ordered one focal policy vs five independently seated copies of a column stage; every seed and every hero seat.
private_hand_slots: Use hand_seed(card,physical_seat); independent draw from four for each seat, fixed across betting streets, same stochastic tape across compared stages.
actions: semantic_seed(card,acting_seat,state), independent of hero assignment. All six positions are seated on the common deck with button zero.
estimator: Average across 6 seats and 3 fixed training seeds within card. Report absolute directed hero bb/100 and by-seed means. Self controls must be identically zero per original card.
intervals: Bonferroni 95% family across six off-diagonal directed means. Separately a three-comparison Bonferroni 95% family for 528 minus 504 vs each fixed population, and one across three reciprocal differences. Normal paired-card intervals. No extrapolation across training seeds.
cycle: Directed dominance A over B requires positive simultaneous lower bound for U(A vs five B) and negative simultaneous upper bound for U(B vs five A). Check both three-cycles. No best response or six-player exploitability is computed.
